test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following became the first Indian woman sailor to qualify for the Olympics in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **Nethra Kumanan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nethra Kumanan**

 
 
• **​Nethra Kumanan**, who was born on August 21, 1997, learned to sail in **2009** at a summer camp run by the** Tamil Nadu** Sailing Association. At the time, she was twelve.
 
• India was formerly represented by **Nethra Kumanan** at the 2014, and 2018 Asian Games, and the** 2020 Sailing World Cup.**
 
• **Nethra Kumanan** won a** bronze medal** in the 2020 Sailing World Cup in** Miami, USA**, becoming the first Indian woman to do so in sailing
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2021**

 
 
• Due to the **COVID-19 pandemic,** the** 2020 Summer Olympics,** which were originally scheduled to take place from 24 July to 9 August 2021, were moved up a year to 2021.
 
• On July 23, 2021, at **Tokyo's Olympic Stadium, Emperor Naruhito** gave the opening address for the **Tokyo Olympics.**
 
• The **theme** of the **Tokyo Summer Olympics in 2020 is "Moving Forward: Unified by Emotion."**
